sequence: Acquire the transaction advisory lock and capture fresh identity, registry, namespace, and billing baselines.
Require all five billing relations to be absent in the public schema.
Run the exact reviewed SQL in the same transaction.
Validate every column name/type/nullability/default, primary and unique constraint, check definition, index column list/definition, and zero-row count.
Assert identity and registry baselines are unchanged before commit; any failure rolls back the transaction.
Read the committed catalog again on an independent read-only connection and require the same shape and empty rows.

limitations: The target has no billing relations or billing data, so there is no existing billing shape or webhook history to fence or preserve.
The secure local artifact records metadata and digests, not a database backup; it does not satisfy the separate encrypted-backup recovery gate.
